description: Single source of truth for the 14 HTML markup + a11y + sentinel rules in spec-lint group #16 (v2.10 schema). Loaded by both scripts/html-validate.py (catalog-driven rule engine with 8 dispatch types) and spec-lint.py (invariant labels). Each rule has a `type` discriminator that selects the dispatch branch: regex_match | regex_capture_nonempty | regex_count_compare | regex_negative_match | regex_capture_min_len | set_membership | nested_inner_text | input_with_label_lookup | sentinel. Adding a rule of an existing shape = 1 edit to the catalog. Adding a rule of a NEW shape = 1 catalog entry + 1 dispatch branch in scripts/html-validate.py:_dispatch_rule(). Named sets (currently ARIA_ROLES, 66 W3C ARIA 1.2 standard roles) live in the top-level `sets` registry and are referenced by `allowed_set_ref`. `sentinel` type is documented but never dispatched (file_missing is emitted by check_page() directly, not by the engine).

rules.label: DOCTYPE html present in every page
no CJK placeholder chars in any page
<button> has aria-label=, aria-labelledby= OR visible inner text
rules.notes: WCAG 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value). Extract <button> tags via regex <button\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</button>, skip those with aria-label= or aria-labelledby=, strip nested tags from inner text via re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', inner), FAIL on any button whose stripped inner text is empty.

rules.label: <a href> has aria-label=, aria-labelledby= OR visible inner text
rules.notes: WCAG 2.4.4 (Link Purpose). Extract tags via regex ]*?)>(.*?), skip those without href= or with empty href (different anti-pattern), skip those with aria-label= or aria-labelledby=, strip nested tags from inner text, FAIL on any anchor whose stripped inner text is empty.

rules.label: role="v" where v is one of the ARIA 1.2 standard role set
rules.notes: WCAG 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships) + ARIA 1.2 discipline. Browsers silently map invalid roles to a generic role, so the markup pretends to be accessible but assistive tech gets no role signal. Set membership check against the ARIA_ROLES frozenset (66 W3C ARIA 1.2 standard roles per the top-level sets registry).

rules.label: <input> (∉ hidden/submit/button/reset/image) has <label for=> OR aria-label=
rules.notes: WCAG 3.3.2 (Labels or Instructions). Multi-step: extract <input> tags via regex <input\b([^>]*?)/?>, skip type=hidden/submit/button/reset/image (intrinsically labelled), skip those with aria-label= or aria-labelledby=, build labelled_ids set from <label for=> regex, skip those whose id is in labelled_ids, FAIL on remaining unlabelled inputs.

rules.label: page file exists on disk
rules.notes: sentinel emitted by check_page() when the HTML file is missing from filesystem; bypasses _dispatch_rule() (returns [] for sentinels) and is special-cased in main() (files_missing += 1; continue). Documented in catalog for completeness so every emitted violation key has a catalog entry — closes the catalog coverage gap surfaced by v2.9 reviewer F2.
